name: Swapna Mishra/ ସ୍ଵପ୍ନା ମିଶ୍ର

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Swapna Mishra writes across poetry, fiction and translation in Odia. Her books include the novels Jaala and Daaga and the poetry collection Shabda Banchi Rahe. She also translated Gyanendrapati’s Hindi poetry collection Sanshyatma into Odia for Sahitya Akademi, bringing another poet’s voice into the language of her own creative work.

The poems collected here repeatedly ask who has the power to define a life. ‘ଅହଲ୍ୟା’ gives its mythic speaker a living, desiring presence beyond the image of stone; ‘ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତରୁ’ reconnects ordinary words with hunger, labour, love and creation. In ‘ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣତମା’, the boat and the stage become images of a speaker choosing her own course. Across these poems, inherited meanings meet an insistent claim to self-definition.
